highlights: Moisture continuity clamp to dampen riparian tunnels
Hydrology shadow applied to ceiling thresholds
Flow drift term used in stability scoring
Edge sealing with gradient-based suppression
Support pillars biased toward saturated terrain
Riparian cave plugging near water sources
Pressure stabiliser using hydrology pressure blend/gradient clamp
Flow shadow weighting aligned with hydrology signature v4
Edge flow-lock bias included in signature context
Anisotropy damping for terrain alignment
Bank stability clamping for erosion control
Confluence boost for tributary merging
Headwater stability for shallow channels
Pressure blend for wetlands to avoid spikes
Rim erosion weight bumped for shore smoothing
Variance weight raised for basin shaping
Outflow channel carving with stability checks
Wetland buffer radius for shoreline softening
Lake shelves for depth-based transitions
Inflow blend for river-lake connections

shared_dll.notes: GameCommon.dll contains shared enums, contracts, signature context, and data models. Must be rebuilt and copied to Unity plugins after changes.
